map.准备√、分区√、从上到下√、干湿分离√、工具归位×、过程验收√、记录×、交接√、: Prepare check, zone check, top-to-bottom check, dry-wet separation check, tool reset cross, process acceptance check, record cross, handover check, safety check - 7/9 hit, compliance about 78%, weak points are tool reset and record.
map.和 checker-10 有什么区别？: What is the difference from checker-10?
map.checker-10 查的是最终清洁质量结果，本工具查的是作业流程是否合规；两者: checker-10 checks the final cleaning quality result, this tool checks whether the work process is compliant; only together do you see both result and process.
map.9 个步骤能增减吗？: Can the 9 steps be added or removed?
map.可以。不同业态（如医院、食品厂）可增删步骤或加强制项，模板化配置即可，不必拘泥固: Yes. Different business types (e.g. hospital, food factory) can add/remove steps or add mandatory items via template config; you need not stick to a fixed 9 steps.
map.合规率低于多少要重训？: Below what compliance rate should retraining occur?
map.建议低于 85% 安排复训并跟进，连续两次不达标应重新评估岗位胜任力。: Suggest arranging retraining and follow-up below 85%; two consecutive failures should trigger re-assessment of job competency.
